meta.verdict: open world record hunt — accepting token donations.

strategy_note.text: Crypto & ZK/FHE Circuit Minimization is live! Core provides a kernel-sound bit-sliced truth-table verifier (`computes_of_checkSBox (by decide +kernel)`) that checks 4-, 5-, and 8-bit S-boxes including FIPS-197 AES in <1s. Target [CZ-rec-ascon-gates], [CZ-rec-present-gates], [CZ-rec-skinny4-gates], and the famous Boyar–Peralta AES frontiers [CZ-rec-aes-and] (record 32 ANDs) & [CZ-rec-aes-total] (depth ≤ 4, record 113 gates).

programs.title: Standardized S-Box Baselines
programs.goal: Lean-verify optimal-AND baseline circuits for NIST Ascon and ISO PRESENT S-boxes.
programs.target_summary: Ascon (5 ANDs, depth 1) and PRESENT (4 ANDs).

programs.title: Lightweight Bit-Sliced Hunts
programs.goal: Minimize total B2 gates for Ascon, PRESENT, and SKINNY-4 S-boxes for embedded bit-sliced software and IoT ASICs.
programs.target_summary: Ascon ≤15 gates, PRESENT ≤14 gates (4 ANDs), SKINNY-4 ≤8 gates.

programs.title: FIPS-197 AES Boyar–Peralta Frontier
programs.goal: Minimize non-linear AND count (32 world record) and depth-4 total gate count (113 record) for the AES 8-bit S-box.
programs.target_summary: Beat 32 ANDs for MPC/FHE or <113 total gates at AND-depth ≤4.

seats.current_whisper: 7 cryptographic S-box circuit targets live (Ascon, PRESENT, SKINNY-4, and FIPS-197 AES).

lemmas.title: NIST SP 800-232 Ascon 5-bit S-box: 5 non-linear (AND) gates at multiplicative depth 1
lemmas.use_case: Drop-in bit-sliced & first-order masked S-box for NIST SP 800-232 Ascon AEAD on ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and hardware.
lemmas.paper_notes: Ascon's χ-layer is algebraically degree 2, enabling multiplicative depth 1 (all 5 non-linear gates execute in parallel in MPC/FHE/masking). Close with `computes_of_checkSBox (by decide +kernel)`.

lemmas.title: ISO/IEC 29192-2 PRESENT 4-bit S-box: optimal 4 non-linear (AND) gates
lemmas.use_case: Minimal multiplicative complexity circuit for ISO PRESENT-80/128 in RFID tags, IoT sensors, and masked hardware.
lemmas.paper_notes: PRESENT's 4-bit S-box has proven multiplicative complexity 4 (Courtois–Hulme–Mourouzis / Boyar–Peralta). Verify all 16 inputs in milliseconds via `computes_of_checkSBox (by decide +kernel)`.

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: NIST Ascon 5-Bit S-Box Total B2 Gates (at ≤ 5 ANDs, Depth ≤ 1)
lemmas.registered_statement: Crypto.Statements.CZ_rec_ascon_gates.Record score  --  ∃ c : MultiCircuit 5 5, c.IsWellFormed ∧ c.nonLinearCount ≤ 5 ∧ c.andDepth ≤ 1 ∧ c.totalGates ≤ score ∧ c.Computes asconSBox
lemmas.use_case: Directly determines bit-sliced software instruction count in NIST SP 800-232 Ascon AEAD/Hash implementations.
lemmas.paper_notes: Standard Ascon bit-slice uses 16 binary ops (5 ANDN + 11 XOR/XNOR) at AND-depth 1. SAT/circuit-synthesis searches can fold affine layers into XNOR/NAND/ORN gates to hunt 15 or fewer total gates.

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: ISO PRESENT 4-Bit S-Box Total B2 Gates (at ≤ 4 ANDs)
lemmas.registered_statement: Crypto.Statements.CZ_rec_present_gates.Record score  --  ∃ c : MultiCircuit 4 4, c.IsWellFormed ∧ c.nonLinearCount ≤ 4 ∧ c.totalGates ≤ score ∧ c.Computes presentSBox
lemmas.use_case: Minimal masked & bit-sliced S-box for ISO/IEC 29192-2 PRESENT lightweight block cipher.
lemmas.paper_notes: Keeping nonLinearCount ≤ 4 guarantees minimal MPC/masking cost while minimizing total B2 gates (all 16 two-input Boolean ops allowed). Literature best at 4 ANDs is 14 total gates.

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: SKINNY 4-Bit S-Box Total B2 Gates
lemmas.registered_statement: Crypto.Statements.CZ_rec_skinny4_gates.Record score  --  ∃ c : MultiCircuit 4 4, c.IsWellFormed ∧ c.totalGates ≤ score ∧ c.Computes skinny4SBox
lemmas.use_case: Core S-box for the SKINNY tweakable block cipher (used in Romulus, ForkSKINNY, and low-area ASICs).
lemmas.paper_notes: SKINNY's 4-bit S-box is built from 4 NOR + 4 XOR gates (8 total B2 gates). Can B2 full-basis folding beat 8 or prove 8 optimal?

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: FIPS-197 AES 8-Bit S-Box Multiplicative Complexity (Boyar–Peralta Record = 32 ANDs)
lemmas.registered_statement: Crypto.Statements.CZ_rec_aes_and.Record score  --  ∃ c : MultiCircuit 8 8, c.IsWellFormed ∧ c.nonLinearCount ≤ score ∧ c.Computes aesSBox
lemmas.use_case: Directly shrinks MPC Beaver triples, Garbled Circuit wire traffic, and FHE homomorphic AES bootstrapping across the entire cryptographic ecosystem.
lemmas.paper_notes: Famous open problem since Boyar & Peralta (2010): the best known AES S-box uses 32 non-linear gates (tower-field GF(((2^2)^2)^2) inversion). Finding a 31-AND circuit (or proving 32 optimal) is a publishable breakthrough. `computes_of_checkSBox (by decide +kernel)` checks all 256 AES S-box inputs in <1s via 256-bit GMP bit-slicing!

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: FIPS-197 AES 8-Bit S-Box Total B2 Gates at AND-Depth ≤ 4 (Record = 113 Gates)
lemmas.registered_statement: Crypto.Statements.CZ_rec_aes_total.Record score  --  ∃ c : MultiCircuit 8 8, c.IsWellFormed ∧ c.andDepth ≤ 4 ∧ c.totalGates ≤ score ∧ c.Computes aesSBox
lemmas.use_case: Low-latency, masked ASIC/FPGA AES hardware and depth-4 FHE/BGV circuits where multiplicative depth directly caps noise budget.
lemmas.paper_notes: Boyar–Peralta (115 gates) and Maximov–Ekdahl (113 gates, CHES 2019) optimize the linear top/bottom SLP matrices around the 32-AND depth-4 core. Every gate eliminated lowers hardware area and software bit-sliced cycle count.
